facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority said on 26 October 2026 it had identified potential sites for 15 new towers under the Universal Access Fund, which already supports 15 towers, to extend services to areas of limited commercial return.

LBR.note: Nothing on public digital-skills programmes or a measured share; skills only named as a factor in adoption.
No budget amount, spending or statement; the Universal Access Fund is named without any figures or law.

facts.fact: The article gives the ITU figure that 32.2% of Liberia's population used the internet, with no year stated, and says about 70% did not use it in 2024.
